reviews.body: Good catch. AI SDK v6 (6.0.77 here) only accepts `maxOutputTokens`, so `maxTokens` was dropped for every Vercel-based provider. I reproduced it on `main` and confirmed the fix covers all three paths (generate, stream and structured output), since they all go through `transformInput`. The per-call value wins over the model-level one, and an unset value stays `undefined`. Tests, lint and types pass.
